WSDL Parser

Source: R/WSDLParser.R
WSDLParser.Rd

WSDL Parser

WSDL Parser

Details

Parses a WSDL file to extract services, ports, operations, and types.

Public fields

doc

The parsed XML document.

ns

The namespace definitions.

element_form_default

The elementFormDefault value (qualified/unqualified).

attribute_form_default

The attributeFormDefault value (qualified/unqualified).

Method extend_namespace()

Add standard namespaces if not present. We create a new vector combining document namespace and standard ones, prioritizing the document's namespace but ensure standard prefixes exist.

Usage

WSDLParser$extend_namespace(ns)

Arguments

ns

namespace node of WSDL document (e.g. obtained with xml2::xml_ns)
